## What and why

A short description of the change and the reason for it.

## Checklist

- [ ] `make test` passes locally (including the SPDX, hard-coded-value and PII checks).
- [ ] New source files carry `SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later`.
- [ ] No deployment-specific values (hosts, addresses, e-mail addresses, personal names, home
      paths) and no real personal data in code, tests, fixtures or documentation.
- [ ] Tests added or updated; documentation updated where behaviour changed.
- [ ] Anything touching rights, authentication or data written to Radicale is called out below.

## Risk and notes

Security-relevant aspects, migration or rollback notes, and anything reviewers should check first.
